haman.name: Haman
haman.title: Haman
haman.dict: Pharaoh's chief man, told to bake bricks and build a tower so that Pharaoh may look for the God of Moses (28:38, 40:36-37). In the Bible, Haman is the minister of a Persian king in the book of Esther, centuries later.

harut-and-marut.name: Harut and Marut
harut-and-marut.title: Harut and Marut
harut-and-marut.dict: Two angels at Babylon through whom people learned sorcery, though they warned each one first, "We are a test, so do not lose faith" (2:102).

hud.name: Hud
hud.title: Hud
hud.dict: The messenger sent to the people of Aad, in the sand dunes of Arabia. They reject him and are destroyed by a roaring wind (7:65-72, 11:50-60, 46:21-25). He has no counterpart in the Bible.

hypocrites.name: The hypocrites
hypocrites.title: The hypocrites
hypocrites.dict: Those at Medina who said "We believe" and did not: they hang back from fighting, make excuses, side with the enemy in secret, and mock the believers. The word belongs to the Medinan surahs (it appears once in a surah counted as Meccan, at 29:11). They "will be in the lowest level of the Fire" (4:145), except those who repent. Surah 63 is named for them, and much of surah 9 is about them.
